title: Configuration profiles and security policies failing on a significant share of devices

maxErrorPct.text: Share of targeted devices in error before the profile is treated as failing

report.title: {Items.Count} configuration {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy is', 'policies are')} failing on more than {params.maxErrorPct}% of their devices

messages.businessImpact: The configuration is not arriving. Whatever protection or behaviour it was meant to provide is absent on those devices, while the console still shows the policy as deployed.
remediation: Open the per-setting status for each profile and find the setting that fails.
Common causes are a setting unsupported on the device's edition or build, and a value that conflicts with another policy.
messages.cannotSee: Only a policy whose device status this tool could read is judged. The older device configuration profiles carry a status overview of their own; Settings Catalog profiles, endpoint security policies and security baselines are judged from Intune's assignment failures report, which may list only the policies that have failed somewhere, so a policy it leaves out is passed over rather than reported as healthy. Endpoint security policies authored as legacy intents are not read from it. A device counted under more than one user can be counted more than once, as the console counts it.
